name: Meshrin

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: Meshrin can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Great Weapon Master
abilities.description: When Meshrin hits a creature with its Greataxe, the attack deals an extra 3 damage.

abilities.name: Marsh Stride
abilities.description: Difficult terrain composed of mud doesn't cost Meshrin extra movement, and Meshrin can move across mud without needing to make an ability check.

abilities.name: Fleet Agility
abilities.description: As a bonus action, Meshrin takes the Dash or Disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Meshrin makes three attacks, using Greataxe or Javelin. It can replace one attack with a use of Triumphant Roar.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage. Immediately after the attack, its javelin returns to Meshrin's grasp, and the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of Meshrin's next turn.

actions.name: Skull-Shove (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Meshrin hurls its javelin at a point it can see within 90 feet. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 49 (14d6) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, if the target is Large or smaller, it is also knocked prone.

actions.name: Triumphant Roar
actions.description: Each creature of Meshrin's choice within 30 feet of it that can see or hear it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened of Meshrin until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's terror for 24 hours.
